say:0:1533602001:0.text: War and the fall of gods have wounded too many...
say:0:1533602001:0.source_cn: 战争与神堕，实在伤害了太多人……
say:0:1533602001:0.male: War and the fall of gods have wounded too many...

say:1:1533602002:0.text: I'll join them in a moment of silence for all who have been lost.
say:1:1533602002:0.source_cn: 与他们一起，为所有死难者默哀吧。
